<section id="0123456789abcdef:2:5-log-replication/5-1-leaders-and-followers:1"><block id="0123456789abcdef:2:5-log-replication/5-1-leaders-and-followers:1#b0" kind="paragraph">The leader accepts client requests and appends each command to its log as a new entry.</block><block id="0123456789abcdef:2:5-log-replication/5-1-leaders-and-followers:1#b1" kind="paragraph">The leader then sends AppendEntries messages to every follower in parallel.</block><block id="0123456789abcdef:2:5-log-replication/5-1-leaders-and-followers:1#b2" kind="paragraph">A follower appends the entries to its own log and replies to the leader with a success flag.</block></section>
<plan_item id="p1" kind="graph">How a client request reaches the log and the followers</plan_item>
<ir kind="sequence">{"type":"sequence","title":"One replication round","participants":[{"id":"leader","label":"Leader","evidence":{"blockId":"0123456789abcdef:2:5-log-replication/5-1-leaders-and-followers:1#b1","quote":"The leader then sends AppendEntries messages"}},{"id":"follower","label":"Follower","evidence":{"blockId":"0123456789abcdef:2:5-log-replication/5-1-leaders-and-followers:1#b2","quote":"A follower appends the entries to its own log"}}],"messages":[{"id":"m1","from":"leader","to":"follower","label":"AppendEntries","kind":"async","evidence":{"blockId":"0123456789abcdef:2:5-log-replication/5-1-leaders-and-followers:1#b1","quote":"sends AppendEntries messages to every follower in parallel"}},{"id":"m2","from":"leader","to":"follower","label":"success flag","kind":"reply","evidence":{"blockId":"0123456789abcdef:2:5-log-replication/5-1-leaders-and-followers:1#b2","quote":"replies to the leader with a success flag"}}]}</ir>
<issues>[{"elementId":"m2","kind":"wrong-direction","note":"The success reply points from Leader to Follower."}]</issues>

A follower appends the entries to its own log
sends AppendEntries messages to every follower in parallel
replies to the leader with a success flag
